verdict.rationale: The product ships as a public GitHub repository whose readable SKILL.md files and standard-library Python scripts users copy or paste directly, so its source is inspectable. The pack never states a license, so the open-license half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: any stated open-source license (e.g. MIT or Apache) and independent confirmation of licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the top of a chat and it runs as a mode.
copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
